meta.title: GPMB, Lda — Industrial procurement and supply
meta.description: Reliable procurement and supply solutions for industrial, commercial and domestic materials in Mozambique.

hero.title: Reliable industrial procurement, made simple.
hero.subtitle: We supply maintenance parts and materials for commercial, industrial and domestic use, supported by a supply chain focused on each requirement.
hero.trust: Strong relationships with suppliers and strategic partners

about.title: The right partner for demanding requirements.
about.body: GPMB, Lda is a Mozambican company specialising in maintenance parts and materials for commercial, industrial and domestic use. We provide accessible solutions, professional service and strong relationships with strategic suppliers.
about.mission: To be a company of excellence in the sectors where we operate, committed to innovation, quality and efficiency in the national market.
about.vision: To be recognised for solid, effective service and relevant solutions for partners and clients, from Mozambique to Africa.
about.commitment: We aim to exceed client expectations through quality and safety, preventing risks to people.
about.downloadAria: Download the GPMB company profile PDF

services.title: Supply solutions for operations that cannot stop.
services.intro: From everyday office needs to specialised industrial applications, we source and deliver the right material.

items.title: Office supplies
items.description: Consumables and equipment for productive workspaces.
items.long: We supply consumables and equipment for productive workspaces, from basic stationery to office furniture, with regular deliveries and managed stock.

items.title: Electrical materials
items.description: Components for industrial, commercial and domestic infrastructure.
items.long: Electrical components for industrial, commercial and domestic infrastructure. We work with certified brands (ABB, Siemens, Schneider) and provide technical support in selection.

items.title: Personal protective equipment
items.description: Safety and protection solutions for different sectors.
items.long: Safety and protection solutions for different sectors, with certified equipment and compliance with international standards.

items.title: Graphic materials
items.description: Materials for visual communication and print production.
items.long: Materials for visual communication and print production for companies and industry, with pre-press and finishing support.

items.title: Welding equipment
items.long: Equipment for industrial welding processes, with training and technical assistance included.

items.title: Lifting equipment
items.long: High-performance safety-oriented solutions for lifting operations in industry, ports and offshore.

items.title: Valves and pumps
items.long: Inspected equipment for industrial applications, tested before delivery to minimise downtime.

items.title: Stainless steel and aluminium
items.long: Corrosion-resistant metals and profiles, ISO and SABS certified, for demanding applications.

items.title: HDPE sheet
items.long: Lightweight, durable and chemical-resistant material, ideal for wear guides, tanks and industrial applications.

items.title: Conveyor belts
items.description: Components and support for conveyor systems.
items.long: Components and support for conveyor systems, with quality assurance and after-sales support.

items.title: Industrial IT equipment
items.description: Computers and equipment for industrial environments.
items.long: Rugged computers and equipment for industrial environments, with custom configurations.

items.title: Hydraulic and mechanical materials
items.description: Parts and tools for maintenance and operations.
items.long: Parts and tools for maintenance and operations, with technical support in component identification.
